verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's hierarchy and grouping with comfortable margins. Its flaws are small: the right end of '20% off' runs into the edge of the peach circle, the bottle is a little small, and there is a lot of empty space above and below the content. B blows the bottle up until it competes with the headline as the focal point, pushes the text column to a cramped ~12px left margin, and wraps the body copy into three awkward lines ('Every mixed case / of Solstice / sparkling.'). That makes B look crowded and lopsided rather than deliberately arranged.
